title: مشروع وطني لتوحيد العناوين و ترقيم مداخل العمارات
why: Draft joint ministerial order on street plates, numbering and municipal addressing plans (national policy).

title: Référentiel national de l'adressage : Plus de 415 000 adresses recensées à Oran
why: Oran pilot holds 415,000 official unified geolocatable addresses; national generalisation to 69 wilayas by 2030 (in service, nationwide plan).

title: Adressage : Le recensement se poursuit
why: 1.5 million official addresses in 12 wilayas; civil protection, Sonelgaz, tax and water users presented applications (used by services).

title: Timimoun : Lancement de la généralisation du référentiel national d'adressage
why: Generalisation of the national address register in Timimoun; over 1.1 million addresses from pilot wilayas.

title: إطلاق رسمي لمشروع تعميم المرجع الوطني للعنونة
why: Official launch of generalising the national addressing reference in Algiers wilaya, national strategy to 2030.

title: Projet de référentiel national d'adressage (RNA) : Un élément essentiel du développement local durable
why: Launch in Ouargla; Oran pilot produced 311,000 official addresses; gradual generalisation to all wilayas.

title: 664 millions de dinars pour généraliser le Référentiel national d'adressage à l'échelle nationale
why: Budget of DZD 664 million for first-phase generalisation in four wilayas; national addressing committee set up.

title: المرجع الوطني للعنونة / Guide NA 00-08:2023 Référentiel national d'adressage
why: National addressing procedure adopted as Algerian standard in March 2023, covering isolated housing (national policy, coverage).
